Key violations include the absence of a written employment contract, insufficient annual leave, excessive working hours, and lack of provisions for overtime, sick leave, and end-of-service gratuity. The review of the document identified multiple compliance issues with UAE regulations, including missing and unclear clauses related to wage payment, payment terms, limitation of liability, dispute resolution, governing law, force majeure, warranties, and intellectual property rights. Each of these issues poses significant legal risks and requires immediate attention to ensure compliance. The review of the document revealed multiple compliance issues with the UAE Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL). Key areas of concern include the absence of lawful bases for data processing, lack of consent mechanisms, and failure to address data subject rights. Additionally, there are significant gaps in data breach notification and cross-border data transfer provisions. The review identified compliance issues regarding the absence of a non-compete clause and the lack of a Data Protection Officer. Both findings present high risks due to regulatory violations.

findings.title: Missing Employment Contract
findings.description: The document does not include a written employment contract for the augmented staff as required by UAE law.

findings.title: Missing Probation Period
findings.description: The document does not specify a probation period for the augmented staff, which is required by law.

findings.title: Excessive Working Hours
findings.description: The working hours of 60 hours per week exceed the maximum allowed by law.

findings.title: Lack of Overtime Compensation
findings.description: The document states that no overtime compensation shall be payable, violating legal requirements.

findings.title: Insufficient Annual Leave
findings.description: The annual leave entitlement of twelve days is below the minimum required by law after one year of service.

findings.title: Missing Sick Leave Provisions
findings.description: The document does not mention sick leave provisions for the augmented staff, which is required by law.

findings.title: Lack of End-of-Service Gratuity
findings.description: The document states that no end-of-service gratuity shall be payable, violating legal requirements.

findings.title: Insufficient Notice Period
findings.description: The notice period of seven days for termination is below the minimum required by law.

findings.title: Wage Payment Issues
findings.description: The document does not specify payment through WPS or within the required timeframe.

findings.title: Incomplete Payment Terms
findings.description: Payment schedule lacks clarity on late payment penalties and methods.

findings.title: Unreasonable Limitation of Liability
findings.description: Limitation of liability excludes all indirect damages, which is generally unenforceable.

findings.title: Undefined Dispute Resolution
findings.description: Dispute resolution lacks specific procedures and arbitration details.

findings.title: Ambiguous Governing Law
findings.description: Governing law is stated as 'laws of the Emirate of Dubai' without clarity on jurisdiction.

findings.title: Missing Force Majeure Clause
findings.description: No provision for force majeure events is included in the contract.

findings.title: Insufficient Warranties
findings.description: Warranties do not cover compliance with applicable laws or accuracy of information.

findings.title: Inadequate Intellectual Property Rights
findings.description: IP ownership and licensing terms are not clearly defined.

findings.title: Missing Lawful Basis for Data Processing
findings.description: The document does not specify a lawful basis for processing personal data as required by the PDPL.

findings.title: Lack of Consent Requirements
findings.description: The document fails to address how consent will be obtained and documented for data processing.

findings.title: Omission of Data Subject Rights
findings.description: The document does not mention the rights of data subjects as required by the PDPL.

findings.title: No Cross-Border Data Transfer Safeguards
findings.description: The document does not specify safeguards for transferring data outside the UAE.

findings.title: Lack of Data Breach Notification Provisions
findings.description: The document does not include obligations for notifying data breaches as required by the PDPL.

findings.title: Missing Data Retention Policy
findings.description: The document does not establish a data retention policy as required by the PDPL.

findings.title: No Privacy Notice Provided
findings.description: The document does not provide a privacy notice to data subjects as required by the PDPL.
